title: —Come along, Dedalus! Bous Stephanoumenos! Bous Stephaneforos!
html_source:
Bous Stephanoumenos essentially means Ox bearing wreaths, namely for sacrifice. Another transliteration from Greek.

(Source, Chp. IV, 168.4-5)

anchor.text: —Come along, Dedalus! Bous Stephanoumenos! Bous Stephaneforos!

phanos!

 —Here comes The Dedalus!

 —Ao!... Eh, give it over, Dwyer, I’m telling you, or I’ll give you a stuff in the kisser for yourself.... Ao!

 —Good man, Towser! Duck him!
anchor.suffix:
—Duck him! Guzzle him now, Towser!

 —Help! Help!... Ao!
